sections.text:
Find N2O from denitrification based on WFPS, NO3, and CO2.
   Used by reaction denitrification denprod (see 70.11, page 390) .
  < Parton1996 (FR NO3 FR NO3 )                   ; Default P96NO3 value.
                   (FR CO2 FR CO2 )               ; Default P96CO2 value.
                   (FR WFPS FR WFPS )             ; Default P96WFPS value.
                   (FR CO2 depth 30 [cm]) >

    FR NO3 : function [ug N/g → <none>] (see chapter 42)
     Parameter (default ‘P96NO3’)
     NO3 effect N2O.
    FR CO2 : function [kg C/ha/d → <none>] (see chapter 42)
     Parameter (default ‘P96CO2’)
     CO2 effect N2O.

    FR WFPS : function [<fraction> → <none>] (see chapter 42)
     Parameter (default ‘P96WFPS’)
     WFPS effect N2O.
    FR CO2 depth: number [cm]
     Parameter (default 30)
     Depth used for converting CO2 from volume to area units.

Log Variables
    N2O: number [g N/cm3 /h] sequence
     Amount of N2O-N generated by denitrification.
